name: Viridis Mining and Minerals Limited
summary: Viridis Mining and Minerals Limited, founded in Perth in 2006, identifies, acquires and advances mineral assets in Canada and Australia, seeking gold, nickel, copper, platinum group elements and halloysite. It wholly owns the South Kitikmeot Gold project in Canada, 11,448 hectares in Western Nunavut's Back River-Contwoyto Gold Belt, made up of seven properties including Hiqiniq, Ujaraq and Gold Bug.
